Upstream source: https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gawk/gawk-5.1.0.tar.xz
  (a copy is in ../../../licenses/sources/, with the build recipe in ../../../licenses/biowasm-build/)
WebAssembly build: Biowasm (https://biowasm.com/), downloaded from
  https://biowasm.com/cdn/v3/gawk/5.1.0/ on 2026-09-30
Build recipes: https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm (a pinned copy is in ../../../licenses/biowasm-build/)

Local changes to the JavaScript loader, gawk.js:
1. exit(status) is recorded as Module.__exitStatus, so that the terminal of the practical keeps the exit
   status of a failed command.
2. The day of the year (tm_yday in the C library's localtime and mktime, which strftime() and mktime()
   of awk use) is the number of days between the two calendar dates. As downloaded, the loader worked
   it out from the milliseconds since 1 January, local time – one hour short in summer time, so that for
   a local time between 00:00 and 00:59 on a summer day it was the day before. The script is
   ../../../licenses/local-patches/fix-day-of-year.py (applied as: fix-day-of-year.py gawk.js; two places).
gawk.wasm is unmodified.
